{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABf7Uteg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzhJYTCI", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 385, "title": "Add experimental PLaMo 3 Translate 2B node with optional TEXT source_lang and target_lang ports", "body": "## Goal

Add **one experimental, browser-local PLaMo 3 Translate 2B** graph AI Node to compare Japanese↔English translation quality and latency against existing OPUS-MT and TranslateGemma. Do **not** remove existing translation nodes or make PLaMo the default until it is evaluated.

The user explicitly prefers **optional typed TEXT input ports for language configuration**, **not Settings controls** or fixed direction-specific Nodes.

## Node and ports

- Internal type: `Plamo3Translate2B` (or equivalent stable new type).
- Canvas / Add Node primary name: **Translation · JA ↔ EN** with existing AI sparkles icon; model subtitle: **PLaMo 3 Translate 2B**.
- Required input: `text: TEXT` (text to translate).
- Optional input: `source_lang: TEXT`. Default on missing/unconnected = **auto-detect source language**. Accept `ja`, `en`, and `auto`. `auto` must be implemented as *omitting the explicit source language* in the underlying template, not as an unsupported literal code. Disallow unsupported/blank values with a clear configuration error.
- Optional input: `target_lang: TEXT`. Default on missing/unconnected = **English (`en`)**. Accept `en` or `ja`; reject unsupported values. **Always explicitly supply the chosen/default target language to the model**, because upstream GGUF templates have changed their default target-language behavior (as of 2026-11-08).
- Both ports accept ordinary existing `Text.value` connections: e.g. `Text('ja').value → source_lang` and `Text('en').value → target_lang`. No source/target select fields in Settings and **no model/direction Settings UI**.
- No language selection flag or model swapping required for direction changes; the **single 2B Node** serves both directions.
- Language inputs configure *subsequent* text/provisional jobs but **must never trigger translation by themselves**. Take an immutable snapshot of current source/target config with each accepted text job to prevent async updates changing an in-flight translation. Honor grouped delivery semantics if received together with `text`.
- Reuse the project's current translation output contract (`text`, `source`, `error`, optional preview and IDs where supported) and queue/Stop/Cancel ownership if feasible, rather than introducing a second incompatible translation pipeline. Explicitly differentiate generated streaming tokens from provisional translation jobs; do not claim that the model itself provides live revisions.

## Model/runtime and licensing

- Official model family provides **0.8B / 2B / 8B / 31B**: [PLaMo 3 Translate official collection](https://huggingface.co/collections/pfnet/plamo-3-translate). This Issue targets **2B only**, not all sizes or a generic model selector. Larger variants may be considered later based on quality.
- Use official/reviewed pinned 2B weights and tokenizer/chat template (e.g. an appropriate licensed GGUF/quantized distribution), pinned revisions and hashes. **Do not bundle any AI weight files** with the Chrome extension; use existing browser-origin `ModelAssetCache` download/verification/progress/cancel/retry patterns.
- Verify a **working browser-local WASM/WebGPU runtime** on desktop Chromium (including actual model prompt formatting, tokenizer, graph Node lifecycle, CORS/CSP, memory limits, packaging). The existence of GGUF/MLX files does **not** mean those formats can be loaded by the current Transformers.js translation Worker. Integrate only a tested self-hosted/packaged inference runtime; no remote AI API, native server, helper app or cloud inference fallback.
- Use the **official PLaMo translation prompt format (PFML3) or accurately supported chat template**. Honor the selected target language and source language. The upstream Transformers/MLX examples require an explicit `target_lang`; GGUF auto-language behavior was updated on 2026-11-08, so do not rely on the distribution's default. See [official PLaMo 3 Translate 2B model](https://huggingface.co/pfnet/plamo-3-translate-2b) and [official GGUF notes](https://huggingface.co/pfnet/plamo-3-translate-2b-GGUF).
- Confirm and retain the applicable PLaMo Community License, third-party runtime licenses and attribution. Show actual terms in the Models card's Details / license link, with any necessary pre-use notice. Do not assert that free OSS distribution eliminates commercial-use or redistribution conditions.
- Keep native macOS compatibility in mind (official MLX variant exists), but **implement the browser Node first**. Avoid requiring a local MLX server or a native host to run the browser Node.
- Include a single PLaMo 3 Translate 2B card in Models, with verified asset state and reasonable resource warning.

## Test usability

- Add an independent Node Playground page to test the **same actual 2B model** (without installing the extension), with text, optional source/target language inputs and both directions. Reuse shared code as practical, not duplicate inference behavior.
- Test cases: Japanese→English default `source_lang` auto / `target_lang` en; English→Japanese with source en / target ja; auto source with explicit ja target; configuration-only port updates not triggering translation; invalid codes; text + configuration delivered together; snapshot behavior with queued translations; Cancel, Stop, retry and cache recovery; initial load/no bundled weights; correct output/error routing.
- Include opt-in real-model inference on a capable Mac + Chrome using representative Japanese and English phrases and report measured load/inference timings and generated strings. Default CI must use deterministic unit/UI/worker tests **without downloading a multi-GB model**; avoid manual approval gates.
- Validate existing OPUS-MT, TranslateGemma, AI palette/canvas/inspector, save/import/export and unrelated nodes are unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Exactly one **experimental PLaMo 3 Translate 2B** AI Node is present in Add Node, searchable by function and model name, with optional `source_lang: TEXT` and `target_lang: TEXT` ports and **no direction dropdown in Settings**.
- [ ] Unconnected source means automatic source identification; unconnected target means **en**; the model prompt always includes the explicit target language.
- [ ] The Node runs real local Japanese→English and English→Japanese translation on desktop Chrome, with no cloud inference.
- [ ] Model weights download on demand, are integrity-checked and cacheable; no weight files are shipped in the extension.
- [ ] Independent standalone web test can exercise both directions.
- [ ] Automated tests cover port config, async job snapshots, lifecycle, asset delivery and regression. Existing translation Nodes remain usable.

## References

- [Node definitions](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/graph.js)
- [Translation scheduler](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/translation-scheduler.js)
- [Translation runtime](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/graph-runtime.js)
- [Model cache](https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/blob/main/extension/model-cache.js)
- [Official PLaMo family](https://huggingface.co/collections/pfnet/plamo-3-translate)
